parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
**M** reacts with hot concentrated acidified $\text{KMnO}_4\text{(aq)}$ to form **N**, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_3$, in reaction 1.

Draw the structure of **N**.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
**N** is reduced by $\text{NaBH}_4$ to form 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid in reaction 2.

Construct an equation for reaction 2 using molecular formulae.
In the equation, use $\text{[H]}$ to represent one atom of hydrogen from the reducing agent.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Reaction 2 is a nucleophilic addition.

Suggest why reaction 2 creates a mixture of two organic compounds.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text: Draw lactone **P**, the product of reaction 3.
